C0953.title: Xinfeng Court in Jiangxi Concludes Forged and Trafficked ID Card Case
C0953.summary: In July 2024, Guangming Online republished a China Court report titled Xinfeng Court in Jiangxi Concludes a Forged and Trafficked ID Card Case. The report identifies a criminal case involving forged and trafficked identity documents handled by Xinfeng Court, making it a factual case for fake identity authentication and identity-document crime risks; defendant names, quantities, and sentencing details should be checked against the original article text.
